summary.text: Elissa Campbell is a Republican member of the Wyoming House of Representatives for District 56 who took office in January 2025 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
She is executive director of a statewide non-profit, the Wyoming Foundation for Cancer Care, according to her Ballotpedia survey responses.

paragraphs.text: Elissa Campbell earned an associate degree from Casper College in 1993 and a bachelor's degree in philosophy and environmental ethics from the University of Wyoming in 1994.

Ballotpedia lists her career experience as business owner, executive director, and training and development, and her affiliations as the Rotary, the Casper Committee on Foreign Relations and the Casper Area Chamber of Commerce.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a third-generation Wyomingite and University of Wyoming alumna who also serves as a trustee of the Casper Youth Crisis Center and board president of the Casper Committee on Foreign Relations.
Campbell won the District 56 seat in the November 2024 general election and assumed office on January 6, 2025, succeeding Jerry Obermueller.
For 2025-2026 she was assigned to the House Travel, Recreation, Wildlife and Cultural Resources Committee and the Air Transportation Liaison Committee.
She defeated Pete Fox in the August 18, 2026 Republican primary, 67.5% to 31.7%.

In the survey she listed her policy concerns as affordable and accessible health care and housing, infrastructure, diversifying Wyoming's economy and cost-of-living issues, and said she supports local control and fiscal responsibility.
